brief: Act for fictional ensemble coordinator Ivo. Prepare actual complete compatible live parts under fully supplied fictional tone/bar rules,with version-specific rights. All works,tone codes,people,licences and services are invented;text score records are not actual audio.

delegation.title: Ivo’s current performance commission
delegation.body: Preserve the accepted full32-bar live set for the currently available flute and transposing reed players,not the old cello roster. Every lawful house or newly licensed bridge needs playable complete parts,correct written-to-sounding conversion and coherent actual bar entries/cadence. House ownership removes rights requests but cannot remove instrument compatibility. Retain lawful old unchanged V1 private rehearsal reference. Assemble/deliver actual full score and own accessible flute/reed parts,repair both held obsolete part copies,give venue full programme and a lawful public invitation or genuinely fully cleared excerpt,execute selected rights fees and send usable current musician handoffs. No notation rendering or external music knowledge needed;all rules and raw tones are provided.

Conductor gets full live score;players get both own-role parts and practical cues;venue gets actual chosen programme150 and text-invitation plan,no private licence fees/request. profile.title: Ivo’s invented writing history
profile.body: Public archive: “We are keeping the whole set, with a new bridge written here in the room.” “The cello starts the last phrase; listen for the flute’s answer.” Private rehearsal notes: “Please count four before bar1. The old purchased sheet stays in the reference folder.” Ivo writes musically concrete invitations and short rehearsal cues; rights bookkeeping stays private.

contacts.title: Private channels and delivery semantics
contacts.body: The coordinator owns all this task and may receive all private task facts. FINISH is a private handoff to private:coordinator and does not send any independent operational message. SEND accepts canonical recipients or their unique protocol aliases and stores an independent private snapshot. External parties receive only their own role-relevant subset. A completed current-version VERIFY establishes actual receiving at a named service. New files and messages do not automatically change old independently held objects. Provenance inputs are audit links, never extra printed pages.

source/players.title: Current instruments and complete fictional tone rules
source/players.body: Current flute F and reed R players are accepted;old cello player unavailable. F written tone equals sounding tone,allowed written65..88 inclusive. R sounds two codes below its written tone:actual sounding=written−2;allowed written60..84 inclusive. To preserve a desired sounding tone,derive its written code from that equation. Both roles must have their own accepted live part across32 bars;do not replace the reed with an unavailable cello or make one player perform both roles. All codes are a supplied fictional score system,no outside theory assumed.

source/joins.title: Accepted musical continuity and revision scope
source/joins.body: The complete live set keeps32 bars and both roles. House H3 pickup motif at bar8 beat4 must sound;do not omit it as a shortcut. A player cannot sound two different tones simultaneously;assign/release notes lawfully to avoid overlap. House bridge final flute tone atbar16 must equal finale first flute tone atbar17 for the accepted tied cadence. H1/H2/H3 house owner permits octave relocation of house low tones,role assignment for the pickup,shortening a house low note to release a pickup beat,and a house cadence revision or consistent house finale transposition. Preserve house low pitch class by integer octaves,not arbitrary semitone changes. C1/R3 grant preserves its supplied bridge concert tones,durations and roles;only current R written representation may be derived. C1-R3 has no pickup and cadence74. House freedom never authorizes rewriting C1/R3.
